algebra.carrier: minimal antichains of the support-local favorable q-state lattice, representing upward-closed threshold regions
algebra.plus: A ⊕ B = Min(A ∪ B), representing union of upward-closed regions
algebra.times: A ⊗ B = Min({a ∨ b | a∈A,b∈B}), representing intersection of upward-closed regions
algebra.interpretation: bounded distributive lattice and idempotent commutative semiring presentation of the upward-set lattice

path_preimage.statement: For tested deterministic two-ply path predicate preimages with terminal constants integrated, Pre(A⊕B)=Pre(A)⊕Pre(B) and Pre(A⊗B)=Pre(A)⊗Pre(B).
path_preimage.interpretation: fixed-path predicate preimages act as distributive-lattice / semiring homomorphisms on threshold fronts

bellman_form.statement: A two-ply threshold transformer is a monotone lattice polynomial over the antichain semiring: current-player action aggregation uses ⊕, opponent-reply aggregation uses ⊗, and composed path preimages are homomorphisms.
bellman_form.mixed_reply_cover: The previously observed Cartesian mixed-cover candidates are exactly the concrete expansion of semiring multiplication ⊗ before antichain minimization.

remaining_problem: Find an output-sensitive compact algorithm/normal form for semiring multiplication and composed Bellman polynomials at earlier ranks/root scale; the semantic operation itself is no longer unknown.
